IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[DIM_SECTOR]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = '[dbo]')
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[DIM_SECTOR]
	(
	 [ID_DIMSECTOR] int,
	 [IDSECTOR_OLTP] bigint,
	 [NOMBRE_SECTOR] nvarchar(4000),
	 [ZONA_PROCEDENCIA] nvarchar(4000)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

--Uncomment the 4 lines below to create a stored procedure for data pipeline orchestration​
--CREATE PROC bulk_load_[DIM_SECTOR]
--AS
--BEGIN
COPY INTO [dbo].[DIM_SECTOR]
(ID_DIMSECTOR 1, IDSECTOR_OLTP 2, NOMBRE_SECTOR 3, ZONA_PROCEDENCIA 4)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/DIM_Sector.parquet'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM [dbo].[DIM_SECTOR]
GO
